grammar_title: 过去分词与 -ing 形式的对比(done vs doing):作定语 / 作状语 / 作宾语补足语
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 4 Discover useful structures:过去分词与现在分词的对比。铁律:现在分词(doing)= 主动 / 进行;过去分词(done)= 被动 / 完成。逻辑主语是动作发出者→doing;是承受者→done。句子地道、火车之旅/旅行主题,答案唯一(选项含两种分词形式 + to do,只有一项成立)。

points.point: 作定语:doing(主动/进行) vs done(被动/完成)
points.overview: 分词作定语修饰名词:被修饰词是动作的发出者(主动)或动作正在进行 → 用现在分词 doing(the train heading west / falling leaves);被修饰词是动作的承受者(被动)或动作已完成 → 用过去分词 done(the road covered with snow / fallen leaves)。

points.point: 作状语:doing(主动) vs done(被动)
points.overview: 分词作状语,逻辑主语就是句子主语:主语主动发出动作 → 用现在分词 doing(Seeing the view, she smiled);主语承受动作(被动)→ 用过去分词 done(Seen from the hill, the lake looks blue)。

points.point: 作宾语补足语:see/hear/find + sb/sth + doing(主动进行) vs done(被动完成)
points.overview: 感官/使役动词后的宾语补足语:宾语主动做某事、动作在进行 → 用现在分词 doing(I saw him crossing the street);宾语承受动作、动作被动完成 → 用过去分词 done(I had my ticket checked / found the window broken)。

questions.stem: From the window we watched the train ____ west across the open prairie.
questions.explanation: train 主动'朝西行驶'、动作进行中 → 现在分词 heading。

questions.stem: The road ____ with deep snow was hard for the bus to climb.
questions.explanation: road 被雪覆盖、是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 covered。

questions.stem: The maple leaves ____ to the ground turned the path bright red.
questions.explanation: leaves 已经落地、动作完成(fall 是不及物动词,完成用过去分词)→ fallen。

questions.stem: We saw a bunch of farms ____ a very large area beside the railway.
questions.explanation: farms 主动'覆盖/占据'一片地、动作进行 → 现在分词 covering。

questions.stem: The signs ____ in French puzzled the two girls at the Montreal station.
questions.explanation: signs 被写成法语、是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 written。

questions.stem: The river ____ quietly alongside the railway looked silver in the moonlight.
questions.explanation: river 主动'流淌'、动作进行 → 现在分词 flowing。

questions.stem: An old garden ____ from a quarry has now become a famous destination.
questions.explanation: garden 由采石场被改造、是承受者(被动/完成)→ 过去分词 transformed。

questions.stem: Mist ____ from the falls slowly drifted across the lake at dawn.
questions.explanation: mist 主动'升起'、动作进行 → 现在分词 rising。

questions.stem: The cobblestone streets ____ with old brick buildings gave the town a European feel.
questions.explanation: streets 两旁'被'老砖楼排列、是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 lined。

questions.stem: The hills ____ gently towards the lake were red, gold, and orange.
questions.explanation: hills 主动'起伏延伸'、动作进行 → 现在分词 rolling。

questions.stem: We finally reached a city ____ on the southern border of Ontario.
questions.explanation: city '位于'某处,locate 此处是被动/完成 → 过去分词 located。

questions.stem: The passengers ____ out of the windows pointed at the distant snowy peaks.
questions.explanation: passengers 主动'向外看'、动作进行 → 现在分词 looking。

questions.stem: The wheat fields ____ by golden light stretched as far as the eye could see.
questions.explanation: fields 被金光照亮、是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 lit。

questions.stem: A train ____ along the St Lawrence River sped towards the east coast.
questions.explanation: train 主动'飞驰'、动作进行 → 现在分词 speeding。

questions.stem: The tickets ____ at the gate were quickly returned to the travellers.
questions.explanation: tickets 被检查、是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 checked。

questions.stem: The advertisements ____ on the walls were all printed in two languages.
questions.explanation: advertisements '挂在'墙上、是承受者(被动/完成,hang 此处被动)→ 过去分词 hung。

questions.stem: The young photographer ____ beside the river offered to show them the old town.
questions.explanation: photographer 主动'坐着'、状态进行 → 现在分词 sitting。

questions.stem: The lovely shops ____ along St Paul Street sold local crafts and antiques.
questions.explanation: shops '排列'在街旁,此处强调被动排布、是承受者 → 过去分词 lined。

questions.stem: Frost ____ on the cold ground confirmed that autumn had arrived in Canada.
questions.explanation: frost 主动'形成/出现'、动作进行 → 现在分词 forming。

questions.stem: The harbour ____ by tall mountains was one of the highlights of Vancouver.
questions.explanation: harbour 被群山环绕、是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 surrounded。

questions.stem: ____ the autumn colours from the top of the hill, I was completely amazed.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 I 主动'看见'→ 现在分词 Seeing(主动)。

questions.stem: ____ from the top of the mountain, the lake looked deep blue.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 lake 被'看',是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Seen。

questions.stem: ____ eastwards, you will soon pass the snowy Canadian Rockies.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 you 主动'朝东行进'→ 现在分词 Heading(主动)。

questions.stem: ____ by its new manager, the small airline finally began to make a profit.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 airline 被新经理领导,是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Led。

questions.stem: ____ what the trip meant to him, the old man said it was unforgettable.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the old man 被问,是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Asked。

questions.stem: ____ along the broad river, the train rocked us gently to sleep.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the train 主动'飞驰'→ 现在分词 Speeding。

questions.stem: ____ from a quarry long ago, the gardens now attract thousands of visitors.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the gardens 被改造,是承受者(被动/完成)→ 过去分词 Transformed。

questions.stem: ____ the same long rail journey before, the girls knew what to expect.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the girls 主动'(曾)乘坐'、动作在前完成 → 现在分词完成式 Having taken(主动)。

questions.stem: ____ in French, the signs at the station confused the two travellers.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the signs 被写成法语,是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Written。

questions.stem: ____ out of the window, the girls watched the prairie roll past.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the girls 主动'向外看'→ 现在分词 Looking。

questions.stem: ____ by the spectacular falls, the visitors stood in complete silence.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the visitors 被'震撼',是感受的承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Amazed。

questions.stem: ____ the wide stretch of the lake, Liu Qian reached for her camera.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Liu Qian 主动'注意到'→ 现在分词 Noticing。

questions.stem: ____ with deep snow, the mountain road remained closed all winter.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the road 被雪封住,是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Blocked。

questions.stem: ____ for a coffee, Anna pointed out the famous sights along the way.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Anna 主动'停下来'→ 现在分词 Stopping。

questions.stem: ____ at the harbour, the tired travellers were warmly welcomed by Lin Fei.
questions.explanation: arrive 是不及物动词,作状语表'已到达、动作完成'用过去分词 → Arrived。

questions.stem: ____ from the CN Tower, the whole city of Toronto looked tiny.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the city 被'看/俯瞰',是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Viewed。

questions.stem: ____ down the curtain, Daiyu saw the bright lights of Winnipeg.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 Daiyu 主动'拉下窗帘'→ 现在分词 Pulling。

questions.stem: ____ in two languages, the menu surprised the visitors from China.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the menu 被印成两种语言,是承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Printed。

questions.stem: ____ a few hours to spare, the cousins went on a quick tour of the city.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the cousins 主动'拥有'几小时空闲 → 现在分词 Having(主动)。

questions.stem: ____ by the railway's history, the photographer began to tell us many stories.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the photographer 被铁路历史迷住,是感受承受者(被动)→ 过去分词 Fascinated。

questions.stem: From the platform we saw an old man ____ the railway track slowly.
questions.explanation: 宾语 an old man 主动'穿过'、动作进行 → 现在分词 crossing。

questions.stem: At the gate Liu Qian had her ticket ____ by a friendly officer.
questions.explanation: 宾语 her ticket 被检查、被动完成 → 过去分词 checked(have sth done)。

questions.stem: Through the window we watched the prairie ____ slowly past the train.
questions.explanation: 宾语 the prairie 主动'缓缓掠过'、动作进行 → 现在分词 rolling。

questions.stem: When we woke up, we found the ground ____ with a thin layer of frost.
questions.explanation: 宾语 the ground 被霜覆盖、被动完成 → 过去分词 covered。

questions.stem: On the lake we could hear the wild geese ____ as they flew south.
questions.explanation: 宾语 the wild geese 主动'鸣叫'、动作进行 → 现在分词 calling。

questions.stem: Back at the hotel, Daiyu found her bag already ____ by the staff.
questions.explanation: 宾语 her bag 被打包好、被动完成 → 过去分词 packed。

questions.stem: From the tower they watched a few old-fashioned cars ____ by below.
questions.explanation: 宾语 cars 主动'驶过'、动作进行 → 现在分词 rolling。

questions.stem: When she returned, Liu Qian found the curtain ____ back by the wind.
questions.explanation: 宾语 the curtain 被风拉开、被动完成 → 过去分词 pulled。

questions.stem: Standing by the falls, we could feel the cold mist ____ against our faces.
questions.explanation: 宾语 the cold mist 主动'吹拂'、动作进行 → 现在分词 blowing。

questions.stem: At the museum the girls saw many old maps ____ carefully on the walls.
questions.explanation: 宾语 maps 被挂在墙上、被动完成 → 过去分词 hung。

questions.stem: From our seats we noticed snow ____ silently outside the train window.
questions.explanation: 宾语 snow 主动'飘落'、动作进行 → 现在分词 falling。

questions.stem: After the storm, the travellers found a few trees ____ across the track.
questions.explanation: 宾语 a few trees 被风刮倒在轨道上、被动完成 → 过去分词 blown。

questions.stem: On the platform we saw a porter ____ heavy suitcases onto the train.
questions.explanation: 宾语 a porter 主动'搬运'、动作进行 → 现在分词 loading。

questions.stem: At the station the girls heard their train number ____ over the speakers.
questions.explanation: 宾语 their train number 被广播、被动完成 → 过去分词 announced。

questions.stem: From the bridge we watched the broad river ____ towards the distant sea.
questions.explanation: 宾语 the river 主动'流向'大海、动作进行 → 现在分词 flowing。

questions.stem: Before leaving, Daiyu had her photos ____ at a small shop downtown.
questions.explanation: 宾语 her photos 被冲印、被动完成 → 过去分词 printed(have sth done)。

questions.stem: Up in the Rockies we saw a herd of mountain goats ____ along the cliffs.
questions.explanation: 宾语 goats 主动'攀爬'、动作进行 → 现在分词 climbing。

questions.stem: When the lake freezes over, you often see it ____ with skaters all day.
questions.explanation: 宾语 it(the lake)被滑冰者挤满、被动状态 → 过去分词 filled。

questions.stem: From the train window the girls watched the autumn leaves ____ in the wind.
questions.explanation: 宾语 the autumn leaves 主动'飞舞'、动作进行 → 现在分词 dancing。

questions.stem: At the border the officer had all the bags ____ before the train moved on.
questions.explanation: 宾语 all the bags 被检查、被动完成 → 过去分词 searched。
